meals.name: Awakening & Breakfast

items.name: Whole Boiled Eggs or Greek Yogurt

suggestions: Phase 1 (Wake-up): 1 glass warm lemon water + 4 soaked almonds, 1 walnut, 1 tsp seeds.
Phase 2 (Breakfast): 2 Boiled Eggs OR 150g Greek Yogurt + 1 bowl Sprouted Moong Chaat.

meals.name: Muscle Recovery & Bone Density
suggestions: 100g–120g cooked rice OR 2 small phulkas + 120g chicken breast curry (max 1 tsp oil) + 1 large katori Aaku Kura (Palakura/Thotakura).
40g dry soya chunks OR 80g low-fat paneer/tofu curry + Kakarakaya/Bhindi/mixed vegetables + 1 glass buttermilk with roasted jeera.

meals.name: Evening Antioxidant Snack
suggestions: 1 medium Guava OR 1 cup Papaya / Pomegranate / Dragonfruit.
1 cup Green Tea (rich in catechins/EGCG to combat skin oxidative stress).

meals.name: Light Digestion & Tissue Repair
suggestions: 1 to 2 Phulkas + 1 bowl Dal with 50g boiled rajma/chana OR 60g grilled chicken/soya chunks + generous stir-fried veggies.
1 bowl thin Ragi dosa / light vegetable-lentil soup + light protein.
